name: BOWEN, the Hon. Christopher (Chris) Eyles

headline.note: The documented post-university career before federal Parliament consists of political staff employment and union work, alongside elected local office and council-association governance. Those categories are excluded from both headline sectors. Hours, exact transition dates and any earlier paid work remain unresolved; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official ministerial biography confirms the degree; reliable secondary biography gives 1994 graduation. Enrolment date and study load were not established. First-person25February2024 transcript explicitly dates beginning university to1991. Does not establish course load or absence of concurrent paid work.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Patrick Carl (Carl) Scully MLA (payroll entity unresolved)

open_questions: Did Bowen have paid employment before the 1994 Janice Crosio role or during university?
What are the exact appointment dates, payroll entities, substantive hours, leave and campaign breaks for the 1994–2004 staff and union sequence?
What were the exact term/remuneration arrangements for Fairfield Council, mayor and WSROC roles, and did any constitute separate paid employment?
When were the Griffith and UNE postgraduate qualifications undertaken, and did they overlap paid work?
research_notes: Systematic follow-up2026-10-01; repaired missing required research_notes and preserved supported existing entries. Material correction:2000–2004 staff employer was Patrick Carl Scully, not Paul Scully. The frozen roster remains unchanged; the record documents resolution of the abbreviated historical name using primary sources.

Added contemporaneous2001 ministerial staff-title observation, three party offices,1991 university commencement and2018 UNE diploma completion. Political staff, union, party, elected office and study remain excluded under the codebook; no claim that this exhaustive-looking sequence proves zero private/public employment.

Searched primary parliamentary historical handbooks, NSW estimates/Hansard, union references, government personal recollections, university alumni records and early-job/leave queries. No personal full-time or campaign-leave evidence found. Budget PDF direct open500 and APH profile403 were source-specific; publicly indexed primary historical records remained available. NSW dynamic Hansard page lacked text on open; indexed version supplied identity.

Excluded false leads: the25February2024 transcript’s1987 Woolworths trolley work belongs to Jason Clare; music executive, US electrician, UK academic and ACT project-officer namesakes were not matched to this member. Newspaper paper-run snippet mixes two leadership candidates and is insufficiently attributable. Partisan claims of no private experience do not establish exhaustive employment history.

Unresolved priorities: pre1994 jobs and university-period paid work; precise staff/FSU boundaries and hours/leave;2001 senior-policy to chief-of-staff transition; council and WSROC term/payment records; Griffith study interval; party remuneration. Last follow-up2026-10-01; advance across the nationwide queue before repeating exhausted broad searches.
